svg.aria-label: Pull from 1Password, push back through a separate store: 1. Connect: onepassword-connect runs the Connect API and sync containers, reading the credentials file from key 1password-credentials.json in Secret onepassword-secret. 2. Stores: ClusterSecretStore onepassword reads vaults in priority order. onepassword-automation writes to the Automation vault only. 3. Pull: The controller turns each ExternalSecret into a Secret and refreshes it on the interval that ExternalSecret sets. 4. Push: A PushSecret copies a Secret's keys into a 1Password item through the write store, so pushes cannot resolve into Homelab.
